title: schoenus subaphyllus
intro: Schoenus subaphyllus, commonly known as the Cushion Rush, is a type of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Schoenus subaphyllus include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and swelling, and exhibit antispasmodic and diuretic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
